subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram album support land by extending the existing `mediaUrls` send/reply/outbound paths, by accepting a new explicit `send-media-group` action, or by deferring album grouping for now?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the permanent API shape affects the message tool contract, Telegram plugin action discovery, docs, fallback semantics, and the open external PR’s branch direction.

options.title: Port album support into existing media paths
options.body: Use `sendMediaGroup` behind the existing `mediaUrls`/attachment payload flow for eligible 2-10 media groups and keep explicit single-media fallback behavior unchanged.

options.title: Accept a separate album action
options.body: Land or sponsor a dedicated `send-media-group` action after maintainers approve the new message-tool surface and document how it differs from `mediaUrls`.

options.title: Defer outbound albums
options.body: Keep current sequential fanout as supported behavior and close or narrow the linked implementation if album grouping is not desired now.

recommendation.title: Port album support into existing media paths
recommendation.body: Use `sendMediaGroup` behind the existing `mediaUrls`/attachment payload flow for eligible 2-10 media groups and keep explicit single-media fallback behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the visible message tool API, Telegram plugin ownership, and the already-posted cleanup review on this issue.
